# vendor/ (gitignored)

Downloaded SDKs / datasheets. Yahan **kuch edit nahi** karte.

```
vendor/
├─ STM8S_StdPeriph_Lib/
├─ STM32CubeF1/            # Firmware/ + Projects/*/Examples
├─ STM32CubeF4/
├─ datasheets/             # RM0016, RM0008, RM0090, PM0044, PM0214, DS...
└─ cmsis/                  # Cortex-M CMSIS core headers
```

In sab ka size 100 MB+ hota hai, isliye git me nahi. Kaunsa version use kiya,
wo `docs/00-setup-windows.md` ke "Installed versions" me likho.
